title: 第4187章 认知误区第4186章 第六天尊
content_zh:
“小子，你怎么突然转性了？”
荒野，离开蓝溪大天尊的宫殿后，太商开口，有些疑惑地问道，“一个排行第六的大天尊，老朽灭了她，也费不了多少力气。”
“不急。”
李子夜微笑道，“我们只要知道这些大天尊在哪里就行，不着急动手，而且”
说到这里，李子夜语气一顿，继续道，“刚才那位蓝溪大天尊演的那么好，我实在不忍心揭穿她，毕竟，能将自己伪装这么好的人，已经不多了。”
“哦？”
太商听过身旁小家伙之言，诧异地说道，“原来，你早就看出来了！”
“她装的有些过了。”
李子夜语气平和地应道，“堂堂大天尊，表现得如此柔弱无害，实在不正常，哪怕有您老人家在场，她也无需这般矫揉造作，南天门世界这般强者如云的地方，以蓝溪大天尊表现出的性格，就不可能走到这个高度。”
九州人族有一句话，他一直非常认同，那便是，性格决定人生！
古往今来，凡是成大事者，可以善良，可以狠辣，也可以六亲不认，不过，绝对不可以软弱。
“她确实是装的。”
一旁，太商平静道，“虽然，她掩饰的很好，但是，本座还是能够察觉到她的气息，有些斑驳繁杂，说明，她的修为并非单纯由自己修来，此外”
一语至此，太商转身看向后方的宫殿，冷声道，“她那座宫殿下方，隐约有一股浓烈的死气，十有八九就是那些被她吸干血气和修为的冤魂所留。”
“白莲花。”
李子夜轻笑道，“能够装的这么自然，必然不是第一次，看来，这蓝溪大天尊非常享受这种欺骗他人的感觉。”
“这种货色，如果不是你阻止，老朽肯定第一时间就杀了。”太商冷声道。
“前辈莫急。”
李子夜目光扫过整个北荒，心平气和地说道，“等那位大天尊感觉到危险，最先遭殃的便是北荒的这些武者。”
“你的意思是？”太商眉头轻皱，问道。

“很简单。”
李子夜面带微笑地回答道，“我们的精力有限，暂时没有时间一一处理北荒的这些双花境强者甚至神境武者，既然如此，还不如将这些事交给那位蓝溪大天尊，前辈想想，一旦北荒的这位大天尊感受到了生命威胁，她会怎么做？”
“要么极力隐藏，要么拼命提升实力。”
太商似是听出了身旁小家伙话中之意，说道，“而她想要提升实力最快的办法，就是去吞噬北荒的其他武者。”
“不错。”
李子夜轻笑道，“像蓝溪大天尊这种人，不可能将命运寄托到您老人家的仁慈上，她肯定会在极力隐藏的同时，拼尽全力去提升实力，这样一来，不就能省去我们不少力气吗，如果蓝溪大天尊主动将北荒的这些双花境、甚至神境强者全部杀光，对我们来说，那可真是太好了！”
北荒有这么一位可以吞噬他人修为的大天尊，当真是整个北荒的福气！
“有道理。”
content_en:
"Boy, why did you suddenly change your gender?"
In the wilderness, after leaving the palace of the Great Heavenly Lord of Lanxi, Taishang spoke and asked with some doubts, "A Great Heavenly Lord who ranks sixth, it doesn't take much effort for me to destroy her."
"No rush."
Li Ziye smiled and said, "We just need to know where these Great Heavenly Lords are, and we don't have to rush to take action. And"
At this point, Li Ziye paused and continued, "The Great Heavenly Master Lanxi acted so well just now. I really can't bear to expose her. After all, there are not many people who can disguise themselves so well."
"Oh?"
Taishang heard the words of the little guy next to him and said in surprise, "It turns out that you have seen it a long time ago!"
"She's pretending a little too much."
Li Ziye responded in a calm tone, "It is really abnormal for the Great Heavenly Lord to act so weak and harmless. Even if you are present, she does not need to be so pretentious. In a place like the Nantianmen world where there are so many powerful people, it is impossible for the Great Heavenly Lord Lanxi to reach such a height with the character shown."
There is a saying among the Kyushu people that he has always agreed with, that is, character determines life!
Throughout the ages, those who achieve great things can be kind, ruthless, or even disown their relatives, but they must not be weak.
"She's really faking it."
On the side, Tai Shang said calmly, "Although she hid it very well, I can still detect her aura, which is a bit mottled and complicated, which shows that her cultivation is not simply achieved by herself. In addition,"
After saying this, Taishang turned to look at the palace behind him and said in a cold voice, "Under her palace, there is a faint and strong death energy. It is most likely the ghosts left behind by her who drained their blood and cultivation."
"White lotus."
Li Ziye chuckled and said, "It must not be the first time that he can pretend to be so natural. It seems that the Great Heavenly Master of Lanxi enjoys this feeling of deceiving others."
"If you hadn't stopped this kind of thing, I would have killed him immediately." Taishang said coldly.
"Senior, don't be anxious."
Li Ziye glanced across the entire Northern Wilderness and said calmly, "When the Great Heavenly Lord senses danger, the first to suffer will be these warriors in the Northern Wilderness."
"What do you mean?" Tai Shang asked, frowning slightly.
"It's very simple."
Li Ziye replied with a smile on his face, "Our energy is limited, and we don't have time to deal with these Double Flower Realm experts or even God Realm warriors in the Northern Wilderness one by one. In this case, it is better to leave these matters to the Great Heavenly Lord of Lanxi. Senior, think about it, once the Great Heavenly Lord in the Northern Wilderness feels that her life is threatened, what will she do?"
"Either try your best to hide it, or try your best to improve your strength."
Taishang seemed to have heard the meaning of the little guy next to him, and said, "And the fastest way for her to improve her strength is to devour other warriors in the Northern Wilderness."
"Not bad."
Li Ziye chuckled and said, "It is impossible for someone like Great Heavenly Lord Lanxi to pin her fate on your kindness. She will definitely try her best to improve her strength while trying to hide it. In this way, won't it save us a lot of effort? If Great Heavenly Lord Lanxi takes the initiative to kill all these Double Flower Realm and even God Realm experts in the Northern Wilderness, it will be great for us!"
It is really a blessing for the entire Northern Wilderness to have such a Great Heavenly Lord who can devour the cultivation of others!
"That makes sense."
